interpretation.plain_speak: Wingless keeps ranking danger very well, but the probability number is too pessimistic. Depending on the held-out phase it predicts roughly 16% to 28% more flips than actually occur. The repeating phase-28/30 result suggests structured state variation rather than simple random noise.
interpretation.north_star_question: The native danger ordering is robust, but a single-phase probability table is not stable enough for cost-aware action. Calibration needs to absorb known cross-phase variation without fitting on the evaluation phase.
interpretation.next_stage: pool several already sealed prior phases into one frozen calibration table, then compare that pooled model against the phase-26-only model on untouched phases 31-33
